whatIs.title: What is Gallurio?
whatIs.body: Gallurio is a portfolio and booking platform for creative professionals. Build a public page with a drag-and-drop, no-code website builder, then manage the bookings, clients, and details that follow every inquiry — all from the same workspace.

portfolioBuilder.title: Drag-and-drop portfolio builder
portfolioBuilder.panelHeadline: Make your first impression feel like you.
portfolioBuilder.description: A block-based, no-code page builder — browse a library of ready-made sections with live previews, no blank screen to start from. Style every block's color, spacing, and type, choose your gallery layout, and apply a brand kit across your whole site.
portfolioBuilder.feature2: Grid, masonry, and carousel gallery layouts
portfolioBuilder.feature3: Per-block color, spacing, and type controls
portfolioBuilder.feature4: Brand kit and theme presets, applied sitewide

bookingInquiryForms.title: Booking inquiries
bookingInquiryForms.panelHeadline: Give every lead a clear next step.
bookingInquiryForms.description: Visitors send structured inquiries straight from your page — the event date, location, and project details you need to respond with confidence.
bookingInquiryForms.feature3: Contact and project details in one view

businessWorkspace.title: Business workspace
businessWorkspace.panelHeadline: Everything that happens after the inquiry.
businessWorkspace.description: Clients, bookings, invoices, and galleries — organized in one dashboard, so less time goes to piecing tools together and more goes to the work itself.

teams.title: Team collaboration
teams.panelHeadline: Invite the team, assign roles, share one calendar.
teams.description: Bring on staff and collaborators with role-based access to bookings, clients, and the calendar — so everyone knows what's theirs without stepping on each other.

transparency.title: Straightforward. Even at speed.
transparency.subtitle: No guessing about what you're signing up for, what it costs, or who's handling payment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Gallurio collects, uses, stores, discloses, and protects personal information when you use Gallurio, visit a Gallurio public page, or submit a booking inquiry through one.

controller.title: 1. Who Is Responsible for Your Information

collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
collect.intro: Depending on how you use Gallurio, we may collect:

account.title: Account and Identity Information
account.body: Name, email address, Google account identifier, profile image where provided, authentication records, workspace details, and preferences.

business.title: Portfolio and Business Information
business.body: Business name, public profile details, service descriptions, images, galleries, branding, page settings, and other content you upload or publish.

bookingInquiry.title: Booking Inquiry Information
bookingInquiry.body: Name, email address, event or project details, dates, messages, and other responses submitted through a user-created booking form.

usage.title: Technical and Security Information
usage.body: IP address, user-agent information, browser and device information, timestamps, logs, and security events.

payment.title: Subscription Information
payment.body: Plan, subscription status, billing identifiers, invoices, payment status, and transaction-related information. Gallurio does not receive or store full payment-card details when payments are handled by Lemon Squeezy.

emailDelivery.title: Email-Delivery Information
emailDelivery.body: Email address, delivery status, bounce information, and limited message metadata for transactional emails.

collect.outro: Please do not upload sensitive personal information unless it is necessary and lawful for your use of the service.

useOfInfo.title: 3. How We Use Information and Our Legal Bases
useOfInfo.item1: Create and operate accounts and workspaces — legal basis: performance of a contract
useOfInfo.item2: Publish and maintain portfolio pages — legal basis: performance of a contract and legitimate interests
useOfInfo.item3: Receive and deliver booking inquiries — legal basis: performance of a contract and legitimate interests
useOfInfo.item4: Send verification, security, booking, billing, and service notices — legal basis: performance of a contract and legitimate interests
useOfInfo.item5: Provide support and respond to requests — legal basis: performance of a contract, legitimate interests, or consent
useOfInfo.item6: Protect the service, prevent abuse, and enforce our Terms — legal basis: legitimate interests and legal obligations
useOfInfo.item7: Maintain billing, accounting, and tax records — legal basis: legal obligations and performance of a contract
useOfInfo.item8: Understand usage and improve the service — legal basis: legitimate interests, or consent where required
useOfInfo.item9: Use optional non-essential cookies or tracking — legal basis: consent
useOfInfo.outro: Gallurio does not currently send marketing emails or use personal information for advertising or behavioral advertising.

userContentPublic.title: 4. Public Pages and Booking Inquiries
userContentPublic.body1: Content that a workspace owner chooses to publish may be publicly accessible, including business names, images, services, descriptions, contact options, and booking forms.
userContentPublic.body2: When a visitor submits a booking inquiry, Gallurio processes the submitted information to deliver the inquiry to the relevant workspace owner and to provide related notifications. The workspace owner is responsible for using the inquiry information lawfully and for responding to requests relating to information they receive through their page. Gallurio may also process that information as a service provider on behalf of the workspace owner.

analytics.title: 5. Public-Page Analytics
analytics.body1: Gallurio provides analytics for user-created public pages. The page-view beacon does not set or read cookies.
analytics.body2: For rate-limiting, abuse prevention, and once-per-day deduplication, Gallurio receives the visitor's IP address and user-agent information server-side. The raw IP address and raw user-agent are not persisted. Instead, Gallurio creates a salted HMAC-SHA-256 hash using the IP address, user-agent, and the current day. The salt rotates daily at UTC midnight, so the resulting value is not intended to be a durable cross-day identifier.
analytics.body3: Analytics may include page views, page or workspace identifier, approximate technical information, and timestamps. Workspace owners do not receive the raw IP address through Gallurio analytics.

serviceProviders.title: 6. Service Providers
serviceProviders.intro: Gallurio uses service providers to operate the platform:
serviceProviders.item1: WorkOS for authentication and identity management
serviceProviders.item2: Google, when a user chooses Google sign-in
serviceProviders.item3: MongoDB Atlas Flex for database hosting
serviceProviders.item4: Cloudflare Images for image storage and delivery, Cloudflare Turnstile for abuse prevention, and Cloudflare DNS and security services
serviceProviders.item7: Lemon Squeezy for subscription checkout, payment processing, merchant-of-record services, billing, tax handling, refunds, chargebacks, and related transaction administration
serviceProviders.outro1: Providers may process information on Gallurio's behalf or process some information under their own privacy policies. Gallurio remains responsible for selecting appropriate providers and using reasonable contractual, technical, and organizational safeguards.
serviceProviders.outro2: Gallurio may also share information when required by law, to protect rights, to prevent fraud or abuse, or as part of a business transfer such as a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets. Gallurio does not sell personal information.

international.title: 7. International Transfers
international.body1: Gallurio and its service providers may process information in countries outside the Philippines and outside your country of residence.
international.body2: Where GDPR applies, Gallurio will use an appropriate transfer mechanism and safeguards required by applicable law, such as an adequacy decision, Standard Contractual Clauses, or another legally recognized safeguard.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.body1: Gallurio uses essential cookies or similar technologies where needed for authentication, security, session management, and core functionality. Public-page analytics described in Section 5 do not use cookies.
cookies.body2: If Gallurio later introduces non-essential analytics, advertising, or similar technologies, they will be documented in a cookie notice and enabled only where the required consent has been obtained. You may change your browser settings or consent choices, although disabling essential technologies may affect the service.

retention.title: 9. Retention
retention.body1: We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide Gallurio, maintain public pages and business records, deliver booking functionality, resolve disputes, prevent abuse, enforce agreements, and comply with legal, accounting, and tax obligations.
retention.body2: Booking inquiries may remain available to workspace owners for an extended or indefinite period because they may serve as business records. Users and workspace owners may delete information where the service provides a deletion feature or may contact us to request deletion. We may retain limited information where required for legal, security, fraud-prevention, backup, or dispute-resolution purposes.

rights.title: 10. Your Rights
rights.body1: Subject to applicable law and valid limitations, you may request access to, correction of, deletion or blocking of, restriction of, or portability of your personal information. You may also object to processing based on legitimate interests and withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
rights.body2: Send requests to support@gallurio.com. We may request information reasonably necessary to verify your identity. We will respond without undue delay and, where GDPR applies, generally within one month, subject to lawful extensions for complex or numerous requests.
rights.body3: You may also lodge a complaint with the National Privacy Commission of the Philippines or, where GDPR applies, with the supervisory authority in your country of residence, workplace, or the place of the alleged infringement.

security.title: 11. Security and Breach Response
security.body1: Gallurio uses reasonable and appropriate organizational, physical, and technical measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. No service can guarantee absolute security.
security.body2: Gallurio maintains procedures for investigating and responding to security incidents and will provide notifications required by applicable law.

children.title: 12. Children's Privacy
children.body1: Gallurio is intended for businesses and creative professionals and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable law.
children.body2: If someone believes a child has provided personal information to Gallurio, they should contact Gallurio so the information can be reviewed and removed if appropriate.

welcome.title: Welcome to your portfolio editor
welcome.body: Here's a quick, hands-on tour to get you up to speed. You can skip anytime.

dragBlock.title: Drag a block onto your page
dragBlock.body: Choose a Preset block from the panel, then drag it onto the canvas. Presets include the editing controls used in the next steps.

blockProps.title: Block properties live here
blockProps.body: Dropping a block selects it automatically — its settings appear in this panel.

contentTab.title: Content: the block's text and media
contentTab.body: The Content tab is where you edit the block's actual text, images, and links.

designTab.title: Design: colors, borders, and corners
designTab.body: The Design tab controls typography, background color, borders, shadows, and animations.

layoutTab.title: Layout: size, spacing, and position
layoutTab.body: The Layout tab controls gap, min-height, alignment, and grid placement.

switchPages.title: Switch between pages
switchPages.body: Switch between the different parts of your portfolio website.

contactForm.title: Your inquiry form
contactForm.body: Click Contact Form to set up the form visitors use to reach you.

contactSetup.title: Contact · Setup
contactSetup.body: The Setup tab sets the form's language, title, and description. The form's fields and layout are fixed.

contactDesign.title: Contact · Design
contactDesign.body: The Design tab restyles the form — text and background colors to match your brand. You can't hide fields, only change how they look.

photos.title: Upload and organize photos
photos.body: Open Photos to create collections and upload images. Gallery blocks pull from a collection.

translate.title: Translate your public pages
translate.body: Switch the language of your navigation, contact form, and collection popups all at once. Right-to-left languages flip the layout automatically.

theme.title: Pick your colors and fonts
theme.body: Theme controls your five brand colors and typography. Every block's style options use this palette.

preview.title: Preview your site at any screen size
preview.body: Switch to preview mode and use the device toggle to check your layout on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

canvasControls.title: Adjust your editing canvas
canvasControls.body: Use these controls to toggle panels, undo or redo, choose a canvas width, and zoom. On smaller screens, open the sliders button to find them.

guide.title: Return to this guide anytime
guide.body: Open Guide whenever you want to replay this walkthrough.

save.title: Save your changes
save.body: Save changes to keep the current draft ready to return to later.

publish.title: Publish to go live
publish.body: When you're happy with your changes, click Publish to push them to your public page.

draftsStep.title: Save drafts and switch versions
draftsStep.body: Save changes at any time. Use Drafts to manage multiple versions. Reopen this tour via the Guide button.

tour.tryIt: Try it to continue to the next step

skipConfirm.heading: Skip the guide?
skipConfirm.body: You'll lose your place in the walkthrough. You can restart it anytime.
